hana: Posting a reproducible oddity: our Python SDK occasionally surfaces raw bytes for 422s and sometimes a generic APIError instead of ValidationError. This breaks onboarding examples and mypy checks.
leo: can you share the callsite you used?
hana: minimal async repro:
```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient, ValidationError
client = RedwoodClient(api_key='x')
try:
    await client.chat.create(prompt='')
except ValidationError as e:
    print(e.errors)
except Exception as e:
    print(type(e), getattr(e,'raw_body', None))
```
hana: observed: `<class 'redwood.errors.APIError'> b"{\"detail\": \"field required\"}"` so no structured `errors`.
priya: sounds like two problems: (A) async transport isn't running the same JSON error parser as sync, and (B) the typeshed doesn't consistently export ValidationError/AuthError so users can't type `except ValidationError`.
leo: agreed. Proposed fix: always attempt json.loads on error body inside a try/except regardless of content-type; canonicalize common shapes ("detail" -> [{"message":"..."}] or "errors" -> list); construct concrete subclasses for common status codes (AuthError for 401, ValidationError for 4xx validation) that subclass APIError; attach attributes: status_code (int), raw_body (bytes), parsed_body (optional[str|dict]), errors (List[Dict[str,str]] for ValidationError).
priya: add `APIError.is_retryable()` (default: True for 5xx and network timeouts) to simplify consumer backoff logic. Also preserve transport exceptions with `raise APIError(...) from exc` so __cause__ is set.
hana: small DX ask: update quickstart with sync+async example showing how to catch ValidationError and inspect `e.parsed_body` vs `e.raw_body`. People copy-paste and then get surprised by bytes.
ci-bot: Created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/908 (py-sdk: normalize error parsing + export exception types in stubs)
leo: plan: runtime change + update errors.pyi + unit tests for sync+async + mypy CI job. Keep APIError as baseclass for backwards compat. Migration note: "ValidationError now subclass of APIError and includes .errors, .raw_body, .parsed_body; AuthError exported; APIError now exposes is_retryable()".
priya: I'll handle types and docs. leo: you take runtime and tests. hana: please verify with your sample app when PR lands.
ci-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/pull/731 (error-parsing-async-typing-fix)
hana: verified local branch: async and sync now raise ValidationError with structured errors. thanks!
